summary: Milestone 5 (Procurement Decision Engine — backend only) tested end-to-end. All 17 pure-function decision-rule unit tests and all 14 new live-API integration tests pass (31/31). API contract, guardrails, only_actionable safety filter, target-price lifecycle (set/clear/validate), multi-tenant auth enforcement, reason-summary language, and sort order all verified against the public ingress URL with seeded demo data.

minor.issue: Endpoints rely on the `user` object returned by `get_user` containing `restaurant_id`. This works for demo@test.com but is untested for edge cases where user record is missing that field — would throw 500 (KeyError). Consider defensive `user.get('restaurant_id')` with explicit 401/403.

Unit tests cannot be collected without PYTHONPATH=/app/backend (no conftest.py adds rootdir). Not a prod bug, but CI/regression runs will fail unless wrapper sets PYTHONPATH. Consider adding /app/backend/tests/conftest.py with sys.path insertion.

action_items: Optional: add /app/backend/tests/conftest.py inserting /app/backend into sys.path so `pytest tests/test_procurement_decisions.py` works without PYTHONPATH override.
Optional: defensive handling if `user['restaurant_id']` is missing in routes/procurement.py (return 401/403 rather than KeyError→500).
critical_code_review_comments: services/procurement_decisions.py is 620 lines — still readable and well-sectioned, under the 700-line threshold. Clean separation between pure decision builder, DB aggregation, and helpers. OK.

Guardrail logic correctly fail-closed: empty `good` observations ⇒ explicit 'no_good_observations' failure before any rule evaluation. Verified against seeded Ground Beef (POOR-only) fixture → monitor_only with low confidence as spec requires.
only_actionable filter in recommendations_for_restaurant correctly drops both non-actionable types AND non-high confidence — safety rule for inline summary verified.
Sort stable & deterministic: actionable priority → desc decision_confidence → canonical_name tie-breaker. Verified on live data.

Target-price lifecycle: PATCH persists target_price_per_unit + target_unit idempotently; passing null correctly clears both; non-positive values rejected with 400; unknown canonical_product_id yields 404. Downstream GET correctly picks it up because recommendations_for_restaurant / recommendation_for_product load canonical_products and gate target on matching canonical_unit.

Reason summary uses probabilistic language (starts with 'High likelihood ...' or 'within your recent typical ...'); no 'overpaying' or imperative commands detected for medium/low confidence items in live data.
Mongo `_id` correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in both price_history and canonical_products reads.
Multi-tenant isolation enforced via restaurant_id scope on every DB query (price_history + canonical_products).
test_credentials: demo@test.com / testpassword (primary), staff@test.com / testpass123 (secondary). Both authenticated successfully.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing Chicken Breast (2c131d7a...) with 10 good observations and Ground Beef 80/20 (e703a4fe...) with POOR-only observations as specified in the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Procurement Decision API is stable. Test harness at /app/backend/tests/test_procurement_api.py covers list, single-product, target-price CRUD, only_actionable safety filter, multi-tenant, auth enforcement, and language checks. Run with: cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest tests/test_procurement_api.py tests/test_procurement_decisions.py -v. Note that unit tests need PYTHONPATH=/app/backend because tests/ lacks a conftest.py.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — all tests pass on first run.
